result.instructions: Tools for Less Annoying CRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Less Annoying CRM data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run lacrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lacrm_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lacrm_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. lacrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: lacrm_get_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Return the user who owns this API key — UserId, name, email and timezone. A cheap way to confirm the key works, and the UserId to use for AssignedTo. LACRM: GetUser.

tools.name: lacrm_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users on the account that you can see (admins see all), with their UserIds — needed to assign contacts, tasks or filter by owner. LACRM: GetUsers.

tools.name: lacrm_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts and companies
tools.description: Search (or list) contacts and companies. With no search_terms, returns everything visible, paged. Returns { HasMoreResults, Results }. LACRM: GetContacts.

search_terms.description: Text to search for across record fields (name, email, phone, company...).

owner_user_ids.description: Only records assigned to these UserIds.

advanced_filters.description: AdvancedFilters, ANDed together. See https://account.lessannoyingcrm.com/api_docs/v2/Advanced/Filter_Contacts for the names/operations your account supports.

Name.description: Filter name, e.g. FullName, FirstName, Group.

Operation.description: Operation, e.g. Contains, IsExactly, IsInGroupList, IsEmpty.

Value.description: Value for the operation (omit for IsEmpty-style operations).

tools.name: lacrm_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact or company
tools.description: Fetch one contact or company record with all its fields (emails, phones, addresses, custom fields, owner). LACRM: GetContact.

contact_id.description: The contact or company id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

tools.name: lacrm_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes, newest first by default — across the whole CRM, or for one contact. Filter by date range and author. LACRM: GetNotes.

contact_id.description: Only notes attached to this contact (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

user_ids.description: Only notes entered by these UserIds.

tools.name: lacrm_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks due in a date range, optionally only incomplete/complete, for given users. If contact_id is given, ALL of that contact's tasks are returned regardless of dates or status. LACRM: GetTasks.

start_date.description: Lower bound of due dates, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: Upper bound of due dates, yyyy-mm-dd.

user_ids.description: Only tasks assigned to these UserIds.

contact_id.description: Only tasks attached to this contact (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

tools.name: lacrm_list_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: List calendar events in a date range, filterable by user or calendar. If contact_id is given, all events attached to that contact are returned and other filters are ignored. LACRM: GetEvents.

start_date.description: Start of the range (inclusive), ISO 8601 date or date-time.

end_date.description: End of the range (inclusive), ISO 8601 date or date-time.

calendar_ids.description: Only events on these CalendarIds (your own calendars only).

contact_id.description: Only events attached to this contact (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

tools.name: lacrm_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List the account's pipelines (e.g. Sales Leads) with their statuses (StatusId, Name, IsActive) and optionally their custom fields. This is the setup, not the items — use lacrm_list_pipeline_items for those. LACRM: GetPipelines.

include_custom_fields.description: Include each pipeline's custom field definitions. Default here: false (they are verbose).

tools.name: lacrm_list_pipeline_items
tools.title: List pipeline items
tools.description: List the items in one pipeline (deals, leads...), optionally only in given statuses or for given users. An empty status filter returns items in all ACTIVE statuses. LACRM: GetPipelineItems.

pipeline_id.description: The pipeline id (from lacrm_list_pipelines) (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

user_ids.description: Only items whose contact is assigned to these UserIds.

advanced_filters.description: AdvancedFilters, ANDed together. See https://account.lessannoyingcrm.com/api_docs/v2/Advanced/Filter_Contacts for the names/operations your account supports.

Name.description: Filter name, e.g. FullName, FirstName, Group.

Operation.description: Operation, e.g. Contains, IsExactly, IsInGroupList, IsEmpty.

Value.description: Value for the operation (omit for IsEmpty-style operations).

tools.name: lacrm_get_contact_pipeline_items
tools.title: Get a contact's pipeline items
tools.description: All pipeline items attached to one contact or company, grouped by pipeline. LACRM: GetPipelineItemsAttachedToContact.

contact_id.description: The contact or company id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

tools.name: lacrm_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the contact groups you can see (GroupId, Name, Sharing, Color), optionally with member counts. LACRM: GetGroups.

include_contact_counts.description: Also return the number of contacts in each group (slower).

tools.name: lacrm_list_contacts_in_group
tools.title: List contacts in a group
tools.description: List the contacts that are members of one group. Identify the group by group_id (preferred) or group_name — not both. LACRM: GetContactsInGroup.

group_id.description: The group id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

group_name.description: The group name, if you do not have its id.

tools.name: lacrm_get_contact_groups
tools.title: Get a contact's groups
tools.description: List the groups one contact or company belongs to. LACRM: GetGroupsAttachedToContact.

contact_id.description: The contact or company id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

tools.name: lacrm_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the account's field definitions (name, type, options) for contacts, companies or pipelines — use the Name values as keys in custom_fields when creating/editing contacts. LACRM: GetCustomFields.

record_type.description: Only fields for this record type.

pipeline_id.description: For pipeline fields, only this pipeline's (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

tools.name: lacrm_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact or company
tools.description: Create a new contact (person) or company record. For a person, company_name links them to that company (creating it if needed). Company names must be unique. If assigned_to is omitted, the record is assigned to the API key's own user (one extra GetUser call). Returns { ContactId }. LACRM: CreateContact.

name.description: Full name of the person, or the company's name.

is_company.description: true to create a COMPANY record. Default false (a person).

assigned_to.description: UserId to assign the record to. Default: the API key's user.

text.description: The value, e.g. an email address or phone number.

type.description: Type label, e.g. Work, Personal, Mobile. Must match a type in the CRM.

text.description: The value, e.g. an email address or phone number.

type.description: Type label, e.g. Work, Personal, Mobile. Must match a type in the CRM.

company_name.description: For a PERSON: the company they work at (created if it does not exist). Not used for company records.

custom_fields.description: Extra fields keyed by the account's field names exactly as LACRM shows them (e.g. {"Lead Source": "Referral"}). Use lacrm_list_custom_fields to find them. Merged verbatim into Parameters.

tools.name: lacrm_edit_contact
tools.title: Edit a contact or company
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact or company. Only the fields you pass change; omitted fields are left alone. Multi-value fields (email, phone, address, website) are REPLACED by the list you pass. Set is_company=true when renaming a company. LACRM: EditContact.

contact_id.description: The contact or company id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

is_company.description: Set true if this record is a company, so `name` maps to its Company Name field.

name.description: New full name (person) or company name.

text.description: The value, e.g. an email address or phone number.

type.description: Type label, e.g. Work, Personal, Mobile. Must match a type in the CRM.

text.description: The value, e.g. an email address or phone number.

type.description: Type label, e.g. Work, Personal, Mobile. Must match a type in the CRM.

company_name.description: For a PERSON: the company they work at (created if it does not exist). Not used for company records.

custom_fields.description: Extra fields keyed by the account's field names exactly as LACRM shows them (e.g. {"Lead Source": "Referral"}). Use lacrm_list_custom_fields to find them. Merged verbatim into Parameters.

tools.name: lacrm_create_note
tools.title: Add a note to a contact
tools.description: Attach a plain-text note to a contact or company's history (newlines kept, HTML/markdown escaped). Returns { NoteId }. LACRM: CreateNote.

contact_id.description: The contact or company id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

date_displayed.description: When the note should appear in history, ISO 8601 date-time. Default: now.

annotations.title: Add a note to a contact

tools.name: lacrm_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a to-do on a user's task list (date only, no time — use lacrm_create_event for timed things). Optionally attach it to a contact. Returns { TaskId }. LACRM: CreateTask.

name.description: Task name shown on the task list.

contact_id.description: Attach the task to this contact or company (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

assigned_to.description: UserId to assign to. Default: you.

calendar_id.description: Calendar to file it under. Default: your primary (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

tools.name: lacrm_edit_task
tools.title: Edit or complete a task
tools.description: Update a task — including marking it complete (is_complete=true) or re-opening it (false). Only passed fields change. LACRM: EditTask.

task_id.description: The task id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

is_complete.description: true = mark complete, false = mark incomplete.

contact_id.description: Attach to this contact instead (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

calendar_id.description: Move to this calendar (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

tools.name: lacrm_create_event
tools.title: Schedule a calendar event
tools.description: Create a timed (or all-day) event on your calendar, optionally with contacts/users as attendees. The timezone of start_date becomes the event's timezone. Returns { EventId }. LACRM: CreateEvent.

name.description: Event name shown on the calendar.

calendar_id.description: Calendar to put it on. Default: your primary (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

is_user.description: true if this attendee is a CRM user. Default false (a contact).

tools.name: lacrm_create_pipeline_item
tools.title: Add a contact to a pipeline
tools.description: Create a pipeline item (deal, lead...) on a contact in a given pipeline and status, with an optional note. Returns { PipelineItemId }. LACRM: CreatePipelineItem.

contact_id.description: The contact or company id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

pipeline_id.description: The pipeline id (from lacrm_list_pipelines) (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

status_id.description: The starting status id (from the pipeline's Statuses) (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

note.description: Optional note shown in the item's history.

run_status_automation.description: Run the status's automation. Default false.

annotations.title: Add a contact to a pipeline

tools.name: lacrm_update_pipeline_item
tools.title: Move or annotate a pipeline item
tools.description: Move a pipeline item to another status (e.g. Prospect → Won) and/or add a note to its history. LACRM: EditPipelineItem.

pipeline_item_id.description: The pipeline item id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

status_id.description: The new status id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

note.description: Note to add to the item's history.

run_status_automation.description: If the status changes, run its automation. Default false.

annotations.title: Move or annotate a pipeline item

tools.name: lacrm_add_contact_to_group
tools.title: Add a contact to a group
tools.description: Add a contact or company to a group (creates a group membership). Identify the group by group_id (preferred) or group_name — not both. LACRM: CreateGroupMembership.

contact_id.description: The contact or company id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

group_id.description: The group id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

group_name.description: The group name, if you do not have its id.

annotations.title: Add a contact to a group
